newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian nickel prices gain on industrial buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian nickel prices gain on industrial buying.

text.p: Indian nickel prices gained on Wednesday from reduced levels on fresh buying by the stainless steel industry for forthcoming festivals, dealers said.
Other base metals were however quiet on limited activity.
Ready nickel rose by 200 rupees to 39,400 rupees per quintal, dealers said. It was down by 100 rupees on Tuesday.

"Reports of rising global prices also helped the recovery," one dealer said. Copper was unchanged at 12,000 rupees and aluminium at 7,450 but sentiment remained subdued on reports of a sharp setback in overseas markets. Zinc was unchanged at 6,325 rupees, lead at 4,950 rupees and tin at 36,000 rupees.
